statement: Customer onboarding requires KYC using Aadhaar and PAN identity documents, validated by format only; no real government verification is performed.
rationale: Scope agreement requires KYC for onboarding while explicitly excluding real Aadhaar/PAN verification from v1; format-only checks keep the simulation buildable without third-party integration.

statement: An account must be reviewed and activated by Bank operations before it can be used for transactions.
rationale: Scope agreement lists account onboarding and activation as a distinct in-scope step, implying a review/activation gate performed by Bank operations.

statement: All money transfers and receipts are synthetic; no integration with real payment rails or real fund movement is performed.
rationale: Scope agreement explicitly excludes real money movement from v1, restricting transfers to synthetic test data.

statement: The Customer role may register, complete KYC, log in, transfer funds, and view/download statements.
rationale: Directly reflects the Customer role definition in the scope agreement.

statement: The Bank operations role may review KYC, activate or freeze accounts, and view the audit trail, but may not initiate money transfers.
rationale: Directly reflects the Bank operations role definition and its explicit transfer restriction in the scope agreement.

statement: Beneficiary management, notifications, and service requests are excluded from the v1 build.
rationale: Explicitly listed as out of scope in the scope agreement.

statement: All account, KYC, and transfer state changes must be recorded with actor, action, and timestamp to support the Bank operations audit trail and defect root-cause analysis.
rationale: Bank operations' role includes viewing the audit trail, and the charter requires auditable state changes and traceable defect handling.

statement: Agent-produced SDLC artifacts must be reviewable, reproducible, schema-valid, source-linked, and subject to human approval before being treated as approved.
rationale: Charter objective 4 sets this as a project-wide requirement for all agent output, including this BRD.

statement: Login and logout must be available to both Customer and Bank operations users, with role-based access control enforced.
rationale: Login/logout are explicitly in scope for both roles, and the charter requires role-based access as part of the journeys.

statement: Statement view is available to Customer and Bank operations; statement download is available to Customer only, in v1.
rationale: Scope agreement lists statement view against both roles and statement download against Customer only.

statement: Security, privacy, accessibility, reliability, and testability apply as acceptance conditions to every in-scope Customer and Bank operations journey.
rationale: Charter objective 5 states these are acceptance conditions, not optional polish, for the whole v1 build.
